from PIL import Image, ImageOps, ImageDraw
from pathlib import Path
folder=Path('/home/user/Desktop/IDS LLM seminar')
imgs=[]
for p in sorted(folder.glob('*.jpg')):
    im=Image.open(p)
    thumb=ImageOps.contain(im, (360,240))
    canvas=Image.new('RGB',(360,270),'white')
    canvas.paste(thumb,((360-thumb.width)//2,0))
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    d.text((8,246),p.name,fill=(0,0,0))
    imgs.append(canvas)
cols=3; rows=(len(imgs)+cols-1)//cols
sheet=Image.new('RGB',(cols*360,rows*270),(230,230,230))
for i,im in enumerate(imgs):
    sheet.paste(im,((i%cols)*360,(i//cols)*270))
out=folder/'contact_sheet.jpg'
sheet.save(out,quality=90)
print(out)
PY"
